question: Marián Hossa prehral finále Stanleyho pohára a v lete prestúpil práve do Detroitu, ktorý ho vo finále porazil. O rok sa stretli tie isté dva tímy a pohár zdvihli jeho bývalí spoluhráči. Z ktorého klubu do Detroitu odišiel?
topic: Slovenský hokej – Marián Hossa v NHL
source_excerpt: Hossa signed a one-year contract with the Detroit Red Wings after the Penguins lost the 2008 Stanley Cup Final to Detroit.

extra.why_interesting: The player assumes switching to the champion is a sure route to the Cup. Here it backfired: the exact rematch happened and the old team won. Slovak fans half-remember the story, so the answer feels reachable. Crosby's Pittsburgh as the Detroit rival is a solid foothold.

topicality.rationale: Historical 2008 NHL transfer of Hossa from Pittsburgh to Detroit; sports history, not current news.

extra.verification_notes: Hossa was traded to Pittsburgh in 2008, lost the 2008 Final to Detroit, signed with Detroit that summer, and Pittsburgh beat Detroit in the 2009 Final (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Marián_Hossa).

explanation: Hossa odišiel za istým titulom, no Crosbyho Pittsburgh vyhral odvetu. Pohár napokon získal až o ďalší rok s Chicagom, ako prvý hráč, ktorý hral tri finále po sebe za tri rôzne tímy.

question: Slovenskí hokejisti získali v roku 2002 prvý titul majstrov sveta vo Švédsku, ale nie v hlavnom meste. V ktorom švédskom meste sa hralo zlaté finále?
source_excerpt: It took place on May 11, 2002 at the Scandinavium in Gothenburg, and Slovakia defeated Russia to win its first championship.

extra.why_interesting: Players tend to guess Stockholm, the obvious capital. The real answer is Sweden's second city, and the twist is that Slovakia had to knock out the home team on the way.

explanation: Finále sa hralo v Göteborgu, druhom najväčšom meste Švédska. Na ceste doň Slovensko v semifinále vyradilo domácich Švédov.

question: Stan Mikita, rodák zo Sokoliec na Liptove, spolu s Bobbym Hullom v Chicagu v 60. rokoch spopularizoval úpravu hokejky, ktorú dnes používa takmer každý hráč. Čo na nej bolo inak?
source_excerpt: With Hull, Mikita is credited with developing the curved-blade hockey stick in the mid-1960s.

extra.why_interesting: Everyone has seen a curved hockey stick and assumes it was always that shape. It is a delight to learn that a Slovak-born player helped make it standard.

question: Traja bratia Šťastní hrali v NHL spolu v jednom útoku za klub, ktorý už neexistuje, lebo sa presťahoval do Denveru. V ktorom kanadskom meste sídlil?

question: Na majstrovstvách sveta 2010 hral v skupine so Slovenskom tím, ktorý ako jediný na celom turnaji neprehral ani jeden zápas, a aj tak nepostúpil zo skupiny. Ktorý tím to bol?
source_excerpt: New Zealand ... were the only team in the tournament to go unbeaten, yet were eliminated after three draws.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume the only unbeaten team at a World Cup must be the champion or at least a big name. In fact it was the group's underdog, which went home after the group stage. A Slovak player can reason it out from the four group members, since Slovakia beat Italy and Paraguay won the group.
